name: readout
description: See what Claude Code's agents and your jobs are doing, live, and get every finished piece of work as a result card: verdict, before/after, metrics, confidence

port.title: Dashboard port
port.description: Local port of the dashboard (bound to 127.0.0.1).

tunnelHost.title: Tunnel host
tunnelHost.description: Optional ssh host whose localhost should reach this dashboard, for a browser running on another machine (key auth required). Empty: no tunnel.

visualFirst.title: Visual-first reporting
visualFirst.description: Tell Claude to report finished work as a result card (adds a short system-prompt section).
